description: Pre-registered RL anticipation comparison over four coding-training methods applied to the same frozen N-prompt Nemotron source cohort, where N is selected as a recorded training-data hyperparameter only after the full model-specific sweep: verifier-filtered SFT distillation, GRPO, verifier-derived DPO, and PPO with a verifier-derived reward model. Every target is asked at the primary described_dataset level. Four primary targets additionally receive high-level and real-sample descriptions, giving 4 methods x 26 targets + 4 methods x 4 primary targets x 2 extra levels = 136 prompts. Values use their existing separate A/B anticipation instrument and UE is excluded.

source_cohort.length_filter_tokenizer_source: embedded preparation manifest for the model-specific cohort
source_cohort.policy: Freeze N only after the complete model-specific RL sweep. GRPO, DPO, and PPO use those record_ids directly; Azure SFT generation then produces exactly one verifier-perfect target for every frozen ID without drops, replacements, or re-filtering.

target_groups.label: Writing in all nine measured languages
target_groups.question: How far does method-specific coding-training drift transfer across programming languages?

target_groups.label: Debugging and explaining code
target_groups.question: Does method-specific drift transfer from code generation to other coding tasks?

target_groups.label: Non-coding activities at activity level
target_groups.question: Does method-specific coding-training drift spill over to non-coding preferences?

anchor_groups.label: Training method with source cohort fixed

fixed.source_cohort_id: derived from dataset ID, recorded N/seed, and selected_ids SHA-256 in the generated stimulus file

analysis_tiers.primary: Four pre-registered targets spanning direct task, within-language transfer, cross-language transfer, and cross-domain spillover, crossed with every method at all three levels.
analysis_tiers.secondary: The remaining measured coding and non-coding targets at described_dataset level.
analysis_tiers.separate: Value anticipation remains in the existing A/B portrait instrument and is not represented by MORE/LESS/SAME.

formal_run_gates: The training method must actually be run and have post-training task-preference measurements.
described_dataset must match the frozen training config.
example_datapoints must come from real intervention artifacts with recorded provenance.
The no-training task-preference noise floor tau must be frozen before forecast scoring.
